answer_1.quote: In this paper, in order to recognize the perimeter of text generation capability of PLMs, we propose TGEA, an error-annotated dataset with multiple benchmark tasks for text generation from pretrained language models.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs include erroneous sentence detection, erroneous span and associated span detection, error type classification, error correction, and error rationale generation.

answer_2.quote: We report precision, recall and F 0.5 scores using the official Max-Match tool ... We report BLEU , Rouge-L  and BERT Score .

answer_4.quote: We also provide human performance on this task. The best model RoBERTa zh is worse than human performance by 26 points.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators were asked to detect erroneous texts, detect erroneous and associated spans, classify error types, correct errors, and generate rationales for errors following a strict annotation protocol including minimal edit principle and quality control via reviewer feedback.
